tool: academic-research-plugin literature-survey scripts/paper_search.py, arXiv field-syntax queries (--sources arxiv --max-results 20)
sources_effective: arXiv only for search. Semantic Scholar /paper/search returned HTTP 429; DBLP returned an HTML bot check, which was not bypassed. One Semantic Scholar /paper/batch call supplied venues and citation counts; one OpenAlex title search looked for Lu et al. 2020 (CIFAR-10.2) and found nothing.

topic_queries.query: (abs:"anti-aliasing" AND abs:convolutional AND (abs:"shift-invariant" OR abs:"shift invariance"))
(abs:"high-frequency" AND abs:robustness AND abs:Fourier AND abs:convolutional)
(abs:"parameter averaging" AND abs:population) OR (abs:"weight averaging" AND abs:"diverse" AND abs:"from scratch")
(abs:"weight averaging" AND abs:"domain generalization" AND abs:flat)
((abs:mixup OR abs:CutMix) AND abs:"distribution shift" AND abs:CIFAR)
(abs:"self-supervised" AND abs:auxiliary AND abs:"distribution shift" AND abs:classification)

seminal_verification.method: one export.arxiv.org id_list request for 50 IDs; title similarity >= 0.70 (ARS arXiv protocol)

unverifiable_and_not_cited_directly: Lu et al. 2020, 'Harder or Different? A Closer Look at Distribution Shift in Dataset Reproduction' (CIFAR-10.2): not found on arXiv or OpenAlex; described only through Miller et al. 2021, Appendix
screening: title screen of 192 unique records -> 41 relevant; plus seminal set by ID; exclusions: off-topic arXiv matches (astronomy, chemistry, NLP, VLM test-time tuning), methods needing pretrained weights or external data (CLIP distillation, generated data, PixMix fractals)
notes: Previous survey (output/literature-survey/2026-10-29-1530) covered augmentation, SAM, SWA/EMA, KD, CIFAR-10.1 line; this round excludes those queries and targets effective robustness, architecture/aliasing, budget ensembles, weight averaging, test-time methods.
